jobs.title: Business Strategy Associate - Lending
jobs.address: Barcelona, 67, Müllerstraße, Afrikanisches Viertel, Wedding, Mitte, Berlin, 13349, Deutschland
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking a highly driven Business Strategy Associate to join our Lending team in Berlin or Barcelona.

You will work in the Financial Empowerment domain. Our goal is to empower everyone to achieve financial freedom and unlock their potential for a better life by providing N26 users with access to the money they need to achieve their life objectives, whether today (deposits or borrowing) or tomorrow (saving and investing).

Here, you will have the unique opportunity to work at one of Europe’s most exciting Fintechs and contribute to our growth and expansion in a cross-functional team. You will be responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of product initiatives through project management, external partner management, and ensuring maximum performance of our different Lending products using data analysis and KPI tracking. You will work on complex projects such as launching new product features while driving business strategy and operational change.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead high-impact Lending initiatives end-to-end, from strategic design through to execution and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the definition and execution of strategic priorities for both the team and the overall Lending segment.
  • Build data-driven business cases to evaluate the impact and feasibility of strategic initiatives and new products, including SQL deep dives and budget building.
  • Oversee the full lifecycle of N26 Lending products, utilizing quantitative and qualitative analysis for continuous optimization.
  • Analyze business performance to identify opportunities for growth, optimization, and innovation.
  • Monitor product and project performance using data and insights to drive informed decision-making.
  • Develop deep expertise in the Lending segment, including its business KPIs, infrastructure, and operational processes.
  • Act as the central point of contact between internal and external stakeholders, including Product & Tech, Legal & Compliance, Customer Operations, Banking Operations, Marketing, and external partners.

What you need to be successful:

Background: 

  • 4+ years of prior experience in financial services—fintech/banking, investment banking, or startups. Direct experience in the credit field is a big plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field (Finance, Economics, Mathematics, etc.) from a top-tier university.
  • Proven track record of leading large, cross-functional projects end-to-end and managing senior stakeholders.
  • Established experience in vendor management, contract negotiation, and partner performance evaluation.

Skills: 

  • Advanced Excel and SQL skills are mandatory—ability to independently source data and derive actionable insights.
  • Ability to build complex business cases and conduct deep-dive research into market and competitor trends.
  • Outstanding storytelling and visualization skills, with high proficiency in presentation software.
  • Highly organized with the ability to navigate shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.    
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. 
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. 

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Operations Technology (All Genders)
jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. Today it is a single engineering team - two staff engineers, a data engineer and seven mid-to-senior engineers - led by the Director of Engineering, owning that software and keeping it running in production. You will join as an Engineering Manager and take line management of the seven.

The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. You won't own a fixed backlog in one corner of the domain; the team's scope follows where the business pressure is. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. In a typical sprint, your engineers might be spread across three projects with three different product managers.

Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You own the people and the delivery of your engineers.

The role reports to the Director of Engineering for Logistics Tech; your team is spread across two geographies.

What you'll do: The Recipe

  • Lead and grow a team of mid-to-senior engineers: set clear expectations, give regular and honest feedback, and own their development - including building the case when someone is ready for the next level.
  • Own the people and stay technical. This role carries real hands-on expectations - you still deliver code yourself, not management at a distance.
  • Keep raising the team's AI bar: role-model it in your own work, and push the workflows where AI genuinely changes how fast we deliver.
  • Make our project-based way of working work for people. You lead project staffing with the Director of Engineering and the product managers, putting engineers where the work and their growth both fit. You limit how many projects anyone carries, and you keep handovers clean so nobody becomes a single point of failure.
  • Own the delivery health of your team's work together with the product managers and the engineers leading each project: realistic plans, sound quality, and systems that stay reliable once shipped.
  • Hire and onboard well - you'll be building the team's balance of skills as projects and domains shift under you.
  • Champion the engineering practices we care about: behaviour-driven tests for every business use case, and small iterations.
  • Help shape tribe culture as part of the leadership team, in a setup that is deliberately flat and collaborative.

What you'll bring: The Ingredients

  • At least 2 years leading mid-to-senior engineers in an agile environment, backed by 6+ years of total engineering experience - you've run development and growth conversations and seen people through to promotion.
  • Comfort leading people through changing project boundaries - this is a team that reforms around projects, not one that sits still.
  • A backend-leaning technical grounding - event-driven microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, relational databases, CI/CD - with real BDD/TDD habits that make large refactorings safe. You don't need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but you need to earn the team's respect.
  • Daily, practical experience building with AI tooling: you've shipped real work with it, you know where it fails, and you learn as readily from others as they learn from you.
  • A product-oriented mindset: you can reason about the business problem, prioritise for customer impact, and push back on low-value scope.
  • Genuine interest in physical-world and supply-chain problems. You want to understand how the operation actually works; logistics or carrier integration experience is a plus.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
jobs.description: About the Role Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay. The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence. You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust. The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move. What You'll Own Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels. Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale. Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation. Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves. Experimentation & Behavioral Economics Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables. Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction. jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
jobs.address: Barcelona, 67, Müllerstraße, Afrikanisches Viertel, Wedding, Mitte, Berlin, 13349, Deutschland
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

In this role, you will

  • Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
  • Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
  • Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
  • Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
  • Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
  • Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

What you need to be successful

Background & Experience

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.
  • High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.
  • Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.

Technical & Domain Skills

  • Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.
  • Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.
  • Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.
  • Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.

Traits

  • Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.
  • Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.
  • Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

What’s in it for you

  • Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.

  • A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.

  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

jobs.description:
About the opportunity

As our new Treasury Trader you will autonomously drive core treasury operations, liquidity and cash management, and investments (with a primary focus on public sector financing). Operating with high autonomy, you will manage the short term Treasury book, central bank operations, assess bank’s liquidity position and monitor key KPIs. Acting as a crucial bridge across Group Risk, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting, you will also as 1 LoD maintain audit readiness to ensure complete operational stability.

You will also enjoy our hybrid work model - flexibility of working both from home, and from our office in Barcelona. 

In this role, you will:

  • Trade Execution & Portfolio Management: Evaluate potential investment opportunities, then price (Bloomberg experience required), execute, and log transactions across Front Office tools, focusing primarily on public sector financing and short maturities. Proactively manage money market products and the short-term book, including Repo and Reverse Repo portfolios.
  • Liquidity & Reserve Management: Oversee key liquidity functions, including Bundesbank cash pooling, Eurosystem minimum reserve requirements, overnight deposits, credit lines, and short-term portfolio hedging.
  • Payment Systems & Central Bank Operations: Serve as the primary deputy for key payment and settlement infrastructure (Target, ESMIG, MACCS) and oversee central bank account management.
  • Audit, Compliance & Governance: Support internal and external audits, enforce compliance with key banking regulations, and drive First Line of Defense (1LoD) risk management.
  • Product & Tech Initiatives: Lead New Product Process (NPP) implementations, vendor onboarding, core banking system enhancements, and automated reporting solutions using SQL.

 

What you need to be successful:

  • Experience: Strong background in bank treasury operations, liquidity management, and money markets, with a preference for hands-on Repo/Reverse Repo and hedging experience.
  • Technical & System Expertise: Solid familiarity with Treasury Front Office tools (Bloomberg experience required), payment and settlement systems (Target, ESMIG, MACCS), and data querying skills (SQL).
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of financial markets combined with a sound grasp of Eurosystem frameworks, reserve requirements, and key European banking regulations (including MaRisk, CRR III, and KWG).
  • Ownership: Proven ability to drive cross-functional projects, step in as a trusted deputy across core functions, and operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.    
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. 
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. 

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

jobs.description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Your main goal as a front line Support engineer will be to help n8n scale exceptional customer support by solving everyday customer challenges and automating repetitive requests, ensuring we deliver a great experience as our customer base grows. You'll make this happen by combining hands-on customer support with smart automation and close collaboration across teams: Deliver Outstanding Customer Support Own and resolve helpdesk tickets for non-enterprise customers, representing approximately 65% of your time. Initially focus on non-technical questions related to account management, account access, plans, subscriptions, and billing. Provide clear, helpful, and timely responses that solve customer problems while gradually expanding your expertise into more technical topics. Automate and Scale Support Operations Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, non-technical ticket categories and reduce manual support work. Build and improve automations that help Team Delta handle growing ticket volumes efficiently without compromising the customer experience. Continuously spot opportunities to streamline support workflows and make it easier for customers to get the answers they need. Strengthen Product Alignment and Knowledge Sharing Collaborate with Product to share recurring customer questions, highlight friction points, and identify opportunities for improvement. Create and maintain documentation that enables customers to self-serve and helps the team resolve common issues more efficiently. Participate in team meetings and cross-functional discussions to share insights, align on priorities, and improve the support experience. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves Technical Support Expertise: You have 3+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or similar roles n8n Experience: You have hands-on experience building and debugging n8n workflows in production environments APIs & Integrations: You’re comfortable debugging APIs, webhooks, authentication, and data flows Cloud & Infrastructure: You’re familiar with AWS, GCP, or Azure and have basic Linux fundamentals for troubleshooting Networking & Databases: You understand networking basics (DNS, SSL/TLS, HTTP/HTTPS) Communication: You explain technical issues clearly and document troubleshooting steps effectively Containerization: You can work with Docker or Kubernetes to deploy and debug automation environments Knowledge Sharing: You actively share knowledge and best practices with teammates, whether through team discussions, presentations, documentation, or contributions to internal playbooks and tools. Nice-to-haves Automation & AI Mindset: You have a basic understanding of AI concepts and a passion for automation, with some hands-on experience using tools like n8n, Zapier, Make, or Airflow to simplify tasks and improve workflows. Observability: Familiarity with tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or Sentry Authentication Protocols: Knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, or JWT flows JavaScript: You have a working knowledge of JavaScript, including reading and debugging code, working with JSON data, and making small code changes to troubleshoot workflows and integrations. SQL & Databases: You have a foundational understanding of relational databases, such as PostgreSQL, including tables, relationships, and basic SQL queries to investigate and troubleshoot issues. Why join us? At n8n, you'll do more than answer support tickets. You'll play a key role in helping us scale our customer support operations, shaping how we use automation to resolve common issues and creating a better experience for our growing customer base. You'll have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on Team Delta's efficiency, collaborate closely with Product, and progressively deepen your technical expertise. You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, working with a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Kann ich mich auf mehrere Stellen gleichzeitig bewerben? Ja, klar! Wenn du dich für mehrere Positionen interessierst, kannst du dich gerne auf alle passenden Stellen bewerben. Achte dabei darauf, jede Bewerbung an die jeweilige Stelle anzupassen. Kann ich mich auch bewerben, wenn keine passende Stelle ausgeschrieben ist? Ja, wir freuen uns über deine Initiativbewerbung! Teile uns einfach mit, in welchem Bereich und an welchem unserer Standorte du tätig werden möchtest. Außerdem hilft es uns, wenn du kurz schilderst, welche Erfahrungen du mitbringst. Wie läuft der Bewerbungsprozess ab? Ein erstes Gespräch findet zum initialen Kennenlernen meistens telefonisch oder per Video statt. Wenn es gut passt, laden wir dich zu einem persönlichen Treffen am Standort ein, bei dem du die Teamleitung und deine potenziellen Kolleg:innen kennenlernen kannst. Je nach Standort und Position ist anschließend eine Hospitation möglich bzw. sogar erwünscht. Was passiert nach der Bewerbung mit meinen Daten? Deine Daten werden vertraulich behandelt und nur für den Bewerbungsprozess verwendet. Nach Abschluss des Verfahrens löschen wir deine Daten gemäß den Datenschutzbestimmungen, es sei denn, du stimmst einer längeren Speicherung aktiv zu. jobs.description: Die ODEG – Ostdeutsche Eisenbahn GmbH ist mit 95 Zügen und jährlich 33 Mio. Fahrgästen die größte private Eisenbahn im Osten Deutschlands. Als zugelassener Bildungsträger nach dem Recht der Arbeitsförderung (AZAV) sowie anerkannte Stelle für Ausbildung gem. § 14 TfV beim Eisenbahn-Bundesamt bieten wir seit Jahren eine Ausbildung mit höchster Qualität. A/B1, um als Triebfahrzeugführer/-in in einen Beruf mit Zukunft durchstarten zu können! Die nächsten Kurse starten am: 09. November 2026 in Schwerin 08. Februar 2027 in Berlin 12. jobs.title: Stellvertretende Kitaleitung (m/w/d)
jobs.company: GFJ - gemeinnützige Gesellschaft für Familien- und Jugendhilfe mbH
jobs.description: Stellvertretende Kitaleitung (m/w/d) für Kita „Fairplay“ in Berlin-Mitte gesucht Sie suchen nicht nur einen Job, sondern möchten etwas bewegen. Sie engagieren sich mit Leidenschaft für die Bildung und Erziehung von Kindern. Sie möchten nach modernen Qualitätsstandards arbeiten. Ihnen ist die Teilhabe der Kinder wichtig und Sie wünschen sich dabei ein motiviertes und kollegiales Team. Mitten im Herzen von Berlin wartet Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz auf Sie. Wir, die GFJ gGmbH, sind ein freier Träger der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe. Zu unserem Träger gehören vier Kitas in Berlin-Mitte und eine Natur- und Bewegungskita in Brandenburg. Unsere Kita Fairplay in der Albrechtstraße (Nähe Friedrichstraße) ist unsere kleinste Kita. Hier werden aktuell 50 Kinder betreut. Der Garten lädt mit seinen vielfältigen Erlebnisbereichen zum Spielen, Forschen und Entdecken ein. In der dazugehörigen Sporthalle haben die Kinder die Möglichkeit, sich auch bei schlechterem Wetter auszutoben. Zur Stärkung gibt es das täglich frisch zubereitete Essen aus den eigenen Kitaküchen. Verstärken Sie unser Team mit Ihrer eigenverantwortlichen Arbeitsweise. Teilen Sie unsere Mission in unserem Haus für eine Welt von morgen und begleiten Sie die Kinder mit Herz und Engagement beim Aufwachsen. Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine Stellvertretende Kitaleitung (m/w/d) für unsere Kita „Fairplay“ mit Option auf Übernahme der Leitungstätigkeit in ca. 2 Jahren. Die Kita liegt zentral und ist mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut erreichbar. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt mit einem kurzen Anschreiben und Lebenslauf. Wir freuen uns Sie kennenzulernen! Ihre Aufgaben Als stellvertretende Kitaleitung ist es Ihre zentrale Aufgabe, die Leitung in deren Abwesenheit zu vertreten. Neben der gruppenübergreifenden pädagogischen Arbeit mit den Kindern arbeiten Sie zu ausgewählten Teilaufgaben mit der Kitaleitung zusammen. Sie erhalten damit Einblick in die Leitungstätigkeit einer Kindertagesstätte und können aktiv bei der Steuerung von Prozessen der Qualitätsentwicklung mitwirken. Ihr Profil Sie sind staatlich anerkannte Erzieherin/ staatlich anerkannter Erzieher oder haben einen Abschluss als Kindheitspädagogin/ Kindheitspädagoge Berufserfahrung in der Kita, Kenntnisse der Offenen Arbeit Fundierte Kenntnisse frühkindlicher Bildungs- und Entwicklungsprozesse Kommunikations- und Kooperationskompetenz Bereitschaft zur Fortbildung und zur aktiven Mitgestaltung bei der Entwicklung des Trägers Wir bieten Ihnen: Jobticket 30 Tage Urlaub Bezahlte Freistellung für den 24.12. und 31.12. Jahressonderzahlungen – Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Interne und externe Fortbildung über ein fundiertes Fortbildungs- und Qualifizierungskonzept Eine moderne und innovative pädagogische Konzeption Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit Möglichkeiten der persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung Ein motiviertes und kollegiales Team Attraktive Vergütungsmöglichkeiten in Anlehnung an die AVB des Paritätischen Wohlfahrtsverbandes Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Als erste Anlaufstelle für Kund innen, Kolleg innen und Partner bist du im Service die Visitenkarte unseres Unternehmens. Wir glauben daran, dass echter Service mehr ist als Abläufe und Prozesse: Es geht um Menschen, um Aufmerksamkeit und um das gute Gefühl, bestens betreut zu sein. Deine Mission bei uns: Du bist Organisationstalent, Möglichmacher in und Stimmungsträger in in einem. Du denkst mit, handelst proaktiv und behältst auch in stressigen Momenten den Überblick. An insgesamt 25 Standorten sind wir mit den Marken Opel, Ford, Kia, Suzuki sowie den Premium Marken Land Rover und Jaguar in mehreren Bundesländern vertreten. Als modernes, zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen setzen wir auf engagierte Menschen, die mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen. Deine Aufgaben: Erster Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) für Kund*innen – persönlich, telefonisch und digital. Freundlicher Empfang und Betreuung unserer Kund*innen im Servicebereich. Terminvergabe und -koordination für Werkstatt- und Servicetermine. Anlage und Pflege von Kunden- und Fahrzeugdaten im System. Unterstützung des Service-Teams bei der täglichen Organisation und Kommunikation. Erstellung von Werkstattaufträgen und Rechnungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Serviceberater. Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen , inkl. Unterlagen, Fahrzeugschlüssel, Leihwagen etc. Koordination und Verwaltung von Mietfahrzeugen am Standort. Kassenführung und Abrechnung. Bearbeitung des Post- und E-Mail-Verkehrs im Servicebereich. Mitwirkung bei Aktionen und Kampagnen , z. B. saisonale Serviceangebote. Sicherstellung eines professionellen und aufgeräumten Empfangsbereichs . Das bringst du mit: Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Empfangs-, Service- oder Kundenbereich. Du bist ein Organisationstalent und besitzt ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Situationen. Ob am Telefon, persönlich oder schriftlich beweist du Kommunikationsstärke und setzt diese gewinnbringend ein.
